profile.headline: Consulting/Principal Software Engineer | Technical Lead Building scalable SaaS platforms • API Architecture • Engineering Enablement • Technical Leadership
profile.summary:
Consulting/Principal Software Engineer and Technical Lead with 25+ years of software engineering experience. Combines deep hands on engineering expertise with architectural leadership to translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions, specializing in enterprise application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, and platform modernization.
 
Transforms recurring engineering challenges into reusable frameworks and engineering practices that improve software quality and delivery efficiency. Partners with engineering and business teams, providing technical leadership through architecture guidance, mentoring, and cross functional collaboration, while remaining actively engaged in hands on design and implementation.

positions.title: Consulting/Principal Software Engineer (Technical Lead)
positions.description:
Serving as Technical Lead, progressed from Senior Software Engineer to Consulting/Principal Software Engineer over 14 years, driving technical direction across software architecture, platform engineering, and cloud modernization for teams spanning onshore and offshore. Partners closely with Product, Architecture, Security, and Professional Services to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions.
 •    Primary architecture owner for a cloud API platform built on ASP.NET Core and GraphQL, from initial design through production and ongoing evolution
•    Established the platform's security foundation, including OAuth 2.0/JWT based authentication and secure third party integration patterns
•    Implemented GraphQL schema governance and API reliability controls, including rate limiting and query complexity analysis, to support external partner integrations at scale
•    Designed a reusable ASP.NET Core microservices framework adopted as the standard foundation for secure, multi tenant SaaS development across the platform
•    Built reusable caching and resilience frameworks, along with tenant management capabilities, used by multiple engineering teams
•    Provides technical leadership through architecture guidance, mentoring, and hands on involvement in design and implementation
•    Actively applies AI assisted engineering practices (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) across the development lifecycle
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET Core · GraphQL · Platform Engineering · API Development · REST APIs · OAuth · OpenID Connect (OIDC) · JSON Web Token (JWT) · Microservices · Distributed Systems · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Technical Leadership · Engineering Enablement · Mentoring · Clean Architecture · Rate Limiting · Distributed Caching · Microsoft Azure · Microsoft SQL Server · Entity Framework (EF) Core · LINQ · OData · Agile Methodologies · Scrum · Kanban · C#

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Progressed from Software Developer to Senior Software Engineer, taking on broader technical responsibilities through mentoring, architecture collaboration, and providing technical direction for a Scrum team of developers and QA engineers.
•    Developed enterprise SOA applications supporting UCC, Business, and other statutory filings for Secretary of State offices in NC, ND, and DC.
•    Contributed to the design and development of eGov360 2.0, a configurable platform developed to support Secretary of State filing systems across multiple jurisdictions. Implemented a flexible architecture that enables customer-specific configuration and customization.
•    Partnered with architects to design reusable application frameworks and workflow engines. Developed ASP.NET MVC applications, WCF services, and data access components using C#, Entity Framework, LINQ, SQL Server, Oracle, and Windows Workflow Foundation.
•    Collaborated with business analysts and customers to refine requirements, estimate development effort, and support proposal (RFP) activities by providing technical input and implementation guidance.
•    Developed Administration Console plug-ins for Insight6, a military unit management application supporting personnel and equipment inventory management.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · C# · Entity Framework · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Contracted through CC Intelligent Solutions to build ADE (Agile Development Environment), a standardized test-development platform that enabled program managers to create, review, and manage assessment content. Designed and implemented the core workflow execution engine, tracking and navigating work items through admin-configured approval workflows and enforcing configured validations, along with the interface for item authors and reviewers to manage their assigned work. Built using MVVM, Entity Framework, and LINQ, with unit test coverage for core data operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework · C# · LINQ · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed insurance rating applications used by agencies across the United States. Contributed to enterprise application development, system integrations, and customer-focused software delivery.
•    Enhanced SETWrite, a comparative rating application for auto and homeowners insurance, by integrating with insurance carrier systems to retrieve real-time rates using XML-based web services.
•    Developed application features using VB.NET, XML, XPath, SQL, and .NET technologies. Built data processing workflows, system integrations, and tools that streamlined routine operational updates.
•    Collaborated with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, and client development teams to refine requirements, provide estimates, and resolve technical issues.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained insurance rating applications used by agencies across North Carolina to calculate and compare auto, home, and dwelling-fire insurance rates between multiple insurance companies.
•    Designed and enhanced RR Win, a Windows-based comparative rating system developed using Visual Basic 6, SQL Server, and XML.
•    Implemented rate updates from the North Carolina Rate Bureau (NCRB) and North Carolina Reinsurance Facility (NCRF), along with carrier-specific business rules to maintain accurate insurance premium calculations.
•    Integrated with insurance carrier systems to retrieve real-time rates through XML web services.
•    Participated in requirements gathering, solution design, and implementation planning. Collaborated with customers and subject matter experts to translate business needs into software solutions.
•    Demonstrated solutions to customers and assisted with troubleshooting production issues.
